title: The Relative peace of the village
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：relative　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 relative 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the cook wrote of ① a relative peace of the village in the menu, and everybody in the canteen said at once that it was ② so relative that nobody in the canteen would go near it. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the cook, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the relative ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the relative peace of the village that anybody there had ever seen, or so the menu for September 1946 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too relative to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the guest who had come to help; the relative ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a relative cost of the journey, and said that no guest in his right mind would call it ⑥ as relative as the cost of the journey they had once had in the old canteen. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was relative or not, and he said so.

By 1959 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the menu. What the line asked for was ⑦ something relative, and nothing besides. The guest from the next canteen called the whole plan ⑧ quite relative; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the menu kept the names of the relative ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1962, at once, she wrote of another relative peace of the village in the same menu, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ no less relative than anybody had expected. ⑩ The relative cost of the journey that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1964, was the one she could never quite name; the relative ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 相对（前置定语 a relative peace of the village：1952 年厨子在菜单里记下的那件相对的安宁）
B. adj. 相对／相关（两处加强说法：so relative that … 与 no less relative than …）
C. adj. 相对／相关（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 相对（表语 too relative to do：母亲觉得它太相对，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 相关（前置定语 a relative cost of the journey：叔叔把整件事称作一桩相关的花销）
F. adj. 相关（同级比较 as relative as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩这一趟的相关花销相比）
G. adj. 相关（后置定语 something relative：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 相关（受程度副词修饰 quite relative：那位客人的评价）

items.q: a relative peace of the village
the relative peace of the village that
a relative cost of the journey
The relative cost of the journey that

answers.why: relative 意为“相对”，1952 年厨子在菜单里记下的是“一件相对的安宁”，此处作前置定语 a relative peace of the village。
relative 意为“相对”，此处用 so relative that 结构，说它相对到食堂里没人敢靠近。
relative 意为“相对”，菜单上 九月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的相对村子相对的安宁，等于最高级的说法。
relative 意为“相对”，母亲认为这件东西“太相对了，谁也用不上”，too relative to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
relative 意为“相关”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩相关的花销”，此处作前置定语 a relative cost of the journey。
relative 意为“相关”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩这一趟的相关花销一样相关”，同级比较用 as relative as。
relative 意为“相关”，菜单上那半行字要的是“相关的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something relative。
relative 意为“相关”，邻食堂来的那位客人认为这套计划“相当相关”，quite 修饰原级 relative。
relative 意为“相关”，no less relative than 表示“其相关不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之相关不亚于任何人的预料。
relative 意为“相关”，母亲 1964 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的相关花销”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年，厨子在菜单里记下了一件相对的安宁。（a relative peace of the village）
它相对到食堂里没有一个人敢靠近。（so relative that …）
母亲觉得它太相对，谁也用不上。（too relative to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩相关的花销。（a relative cost of the journey）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩这一趟的相关花销一样相关。（as relative as …）
到了 1959 年，菜单上只剩半行字：要的是一件相关的东西。（something relative）
answers: In 1952 the cook wrote of a relative peace of the village in the menu.
It was so relative that nobody in the canteen would go near it.
My mother thought it too relative to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a relative cost of the journey.
He said nobody would call it as relative as the cost of the journey they had once had.
By 1959 the menu asked for nothing but something relative.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 relative 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the cook wrote of a relative peace of the village in the menu, and nobody forgot it.
It was the relative peace of the village that anybody there had ever seen, or so the menu says.
My mother thought it too relative to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a relative cost of the journey, and nobody argued with him.
The guest from the next canteen called the plan quite relative, and everybody laughed.
The relative ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
